svg.aria-label: AWS ELB for Envoy overview. Clients call the proxy DNS name and reach the proxy network interfaces in your VPC, behind your security groups. ELB for Envoy, managed by AWS, runs Envoy 1.40 nodes across Availability Zones, scaled and patched by AWS, with optional AWS WAF and an ACM certificate, and routes requests to targets such as EC2 instances and EKS Pods. Configuration comes from config.yaml applied with create-proxy or update-proxy-configuration, or from an xDS control plane or Envoy Gateway on EKS. Logs and metrics go to CloudWatch under /aws/elb-proxy/<name> and AWS/ProxyELB.
svg.title: AWS ELB for Envoy: clients, the AWS-managed Envoy proxy in your VPC, targets, configuration, and CloudWatch
svg.text: Your Envoy config, run by AWS
